claims.statement: The Persistence tool window shows persistence units, managed entities and Spring repositories for the project.
claims.supports: tool window shows configuration files, persistence units, managed entities, Spring repositories, converters

claims.statement: Entities are usually detected automatically from @Entity; a persistence unit can also be created manually.
